entries.title: Wealth stars
entries.content: Wealth is the element your Day Master controls. Direct Wealth is read as steady pay; Indirect Wealth as deals, side hustles and risk.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Output makes money
entries.content: Eating God and Hurting Officer (the element you create) are read as skills and creativity that turn into income.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Officer and structure
entries.content: The element that controls your Day Master is the Officer: jobs, bosses, rules and titles. Strong Officer charts are often read as suited to big organizations.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Resource and study
entries.content: The element that feeds you is Resource: school, credentials, mentors and rest. Resource years are read as good for learning.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Element and work fields
entries.content: Traditional pairings: Wood - education, growth, plants; Fire - media, food, energy; Earth - real estate, care, logistics; Metal - finance, law, tools, tech; Water - trade, travel, communication.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Money is your call
entries.content: Saju is for reflection, not financial advice. Make money decisions with real numbers and, for big ones, a licensed advisor.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection
